audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet both read Ziggs/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei, and phases[0].why described Hwei out-ranging everything on a row that belongs to Ziggs.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 with a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and costs 50 mana, so Ziggs owns level 1; from level 3 the full palette out-trades a single-spell rotation. The lane sits at 50.03% over 1493 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 to Ziggs with a matching why, levels 2-3 to Hwei, 4-5 Skill, 6 and both item rows to Hwei.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Ziggs cooldown appeared anywhere, so 'commit on Satchel Charge's cooldown' had no number attached to it.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Bouncing Bomb 6s down to 4s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: Windows now keyed to Satchel's 20s at rank 1 and Minefield's flat 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge was described only as an escape, and wants.you[2] called Hexplosive Minefield an escape too.
audit.why: Satchel Charge knocks enemies away and self-knocks Ziggs, so it is both his disengage and a displacement that can push you out of your own paint. Hexplosive Minefield is a 900-range slowing zone, not mobility — it is what stops you walking him down after a root.
audit.corrected: Track Satchel as a 20s displacement, and treat the Minefield as ground you cannot chase through rather than an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles; wants.you and wants.foe each had three entries.
audit.why: Lint flagged both bleeds; the fourth want is a structural gap.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten and a fourth want created on each side.

notes: The _missing feed listed 'resistances-invalidated (Satchel Charge)' for this matchup, driven by a percentHealth derived flag on Ziggs' W. Riot's own W text describes damage plus a knock-away with no percent-health component, so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about resistances being invalidated — recorded as a flag misfire. wants.you[2] told you to root his 'hexplosive minefield escapes'; the Minefield is a 900-range slow zone, not mobility, and Satchel Charge is the actual escape. Structural gap filled: both wants arrays had 3 entries, so a fourth was added on each with before:null. phases[0].why was rewritten in the same proposal as the side flip because it described Hwei winning a row that belongs to Ziggs.
